Based on the ingest worker code: successful imports have their original uploaded file deleted from storage immediately after the transactions are inserted (see `storage.remove(upload.key)` in `processJob`). Failed uploads are kept longer so the file can be inspected for troubleshooting, but are automatically purged from storage once they are older than `FAILED_UPLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS` (currently 7 days), via the hourly `purgeExpiredFailedUploads` job. So: successful imports — not retained beyond job completion; failed imports — retained up to 7 days, then deleted.
